_doc: The base on the arena roof (1.7 step 3), Godot metres, roof centre = 0. Slots follow SimState.rooms: three large (6 x 4.5 m) then three small (3 x 3 m), clear of the roof's water tower, AC units, sandbags and hut (game/level/style15_level.tscn). Spots off the rooms: [x, z, yaw] (yaw 0 faces +Z). Claude's layout, J to judge on screen.

pile.note: where site_pile stands during an upgrade, slot-local

fire_barrel_note: oil drums lit at dusk (18:00 on) by whoever is up, out at 07:00; people warm their hands round them at night

farm.note: each planter grows through 5 stages (tilled, sprouts, young, grown, ripe) every cycle_hours of farm work (RoomState.worked), staggered so the beds are never all alike; a ripe bed is harvested and tilled again. Tasks per stage [clip, item in hand]: hoe the bare bed, sow and feed it, water it, weed it, harvest it. Crops: food crops in turn; herbs in the last bed while grow_herbs is queued
